name: Direct Insurance (IDI)
description: IDI Insurance, Israel's pioneer direct insurer (operating since 1994), runs the Direct Insurance (Bituach Yashir) and Bituach 9 brands, both heavy TV advertisers.

notes: Direct Insurance moved from BBR Saatchi & Saatchi (Baumann Ber Rivnay) to McCann Tel Aviv in Sep 2021; Bituach 9 (Glickman-Shamir-Samsonov) was the most-liked advertiser of 2025 in Globes' index. Agency as of 2026-10: McCann Tel Aviv lists Direct Insurance among its main budgets (Globes, Oct 2026).
